basis: source audit plus the live deterministic run; COG-3 capability matrix carried forward where unchanged

compositionInputs: profile.reasoning -> reasoning store + host-derived branch port
profile.repository + world observation -> ProjectWorld basis runtime
options.host.workWorkerFacts + dshHomePath -> D2 work worker port
options.projectIntentAdmission -> Project Intent authority (NOT supplied by the DSH host)
profile.trajectory -> experimental worker-prompt Trajectory capsule delivery (default off)

capabilities.modelReachable: indirect: palimpsest_begin/finish for in-place direct work; palimpsest_manage step/run for D2 worktree work
capabilities.observed: two real ATTEMPT_RESULTs produced by the deterministic test-owned worker; completion evaluator recorded write_scope_valid + expected_files_exist; the documentation/data write scope narrowed the standard command out by the declared applicability rule
capabilities.limitations: a documentation/data result has no command evidence; the standard's command applies only to non-documentation write scopes

capabilities.observed: the packaged service resolved both ATTEMPT_RESULTs and reported a result manifest digest
capabilities.limitations: the result content is not a model-facing field; the model sees task/attempt state and can read the execution world on disk

capabilities.observed: both attempts captured a source-bound basis at the seed revision; currentness CURRENT before any change
capabilities.limitations: assets/environment facets are NOT_REQUIRED for these works; projectSemantic has no first-party change observer

capabilities.lifecycleOwner: stateless orchestration over D3 + D2 owners

observed.INCOMPATIBLE: both results after the vendor update; both results after the newsletter update

capabilities.limitations: the packaged face is scoped to ATTEMPT_RESULT and uses wholeRepositoryRead() for result reads; every source change overlaps that footprint, so COMPATIBLE is structurally unreachable for a source change. The projectSemantic/assets/environment change facets are UNAVAILABLE, so the normal route also cannot produce a clean UNKNOWN. No model-facing tool exposes inspect.

capabilities.composedInNormalHost: not as a model surface; the same kernel is composed inside the packaged service

observed.COMPATIBLE: cost-schedule for external changes since its own result; 8 disjointness proofs, ADMITTED
observed.INCOMPATIBLE: technical-fit for the vendor capability change; conflict on sources/vendor-capabilities.csv
observed.UNKNOWN: technical-fit with an unavailable projectSemantic premise; change_coverage gaps, no conflict, INSUFFICIENT_PROOF

capabilities.limitations: the expert diagnostic used a test-owned instrumented read set (CONSERVATIVE_DOMAIN) to attest the deterministic worker's actual reads; this is not the packaged first-party read footprint. A production caller cannot obtain this narrower coverage from the current Work path.

capabilities.observed: COMPATIBLE expert certificate ADMITTED; UNKNOWN certificate refused with INSUFFICIENT_PROOF; admission != promotion
capabilities.limitations: the packaged service never offers rematerialization for a source change, so the admitted expert certificate had no packaged carry route

capabilities.observed: packaged rematerialize refused for the INCOMPATIBLE technical result; no MATERIALIZED result
capabilities.limitations: not exercised end to end because the packaged assessment did not offer it; a positive rematerialization on a sandbox-enforced read footprint is out of the normal path

capabilities.observed: the service minted the permit and reopened technical-fit to READY after the vendor change; the D2 job then reported HOST_ERROR/HEAD_BASIS_MISMATCH because the live repository head was ahead of the canonical project head; no new attempt was created
capabilities.limitations: the continuation target observation (live HEAD) and the execution base (canonical head) diverged after the external source updates. The product refused honestly; it did not fabricate a current-basis rework.

capabilities.observed: cost-schedule promoted; task SATISFIED; PROMOTION_COMMITTED event; duplicate promotion returned the same terminal event (idempotent); the project head was later reconciled after the technical task became READY
capabilities.limitations: promotion is an operator action; the model cannot promote. A promoted result's own output is part of the origin-to-current diff, so the packaged continuation can report a write collision with the result itself.

capabilities.observed: P fresh Agent read the journal; three entries (negative result, open question, grant conditions) were available and used
capabilities.limitations: journal entries are knowledge, not Evidence; a journal entry does not move the project head or prove compatibility

capabilities.composedInNormalHost: composed only when the caller supplies projectIntentAdmission; the DSH host supplies none
capabilities.observed: not exercised by the model; no structured proposal and no PROJECT_REVISED event. The source audit shows a normal-host apply would return authority_unresolved.
capabilities.limitations: no model-facing tool and no normal-host admission authority; an operator could invoke the expert service with a declared authority, but that would be an operator diagnostic, not model authority

capabilities.modelReachable: only through an experimental worker prompt when profile.trajectory is set; no principal tool
capabilities.observed: not exercised; the deterministic worker has no model Session binding, so the Attempt lineage is not a qualified Trajectory source
capabilities.limitations: do not force Trajectory when the Attempt binding/source qualification is absent

capabilities.modelReachable: through ordinary repository tools and the packaged world observation
capabilities.authority: firstPartyProjectWorldObservation (live git HEAD) + git source observer
capabilities.observed: the packaged and expert diagnostics observed the vendor and newsletter commits as source changes; the canonical project head did not adopt them
capabilities.limitations: the live head and the canonical head can diverge; rework execution starts at the canonical head, not the observed live head

capabilities.observed: blocked by quiescence while technical-fit was VERIFYING; in_sync after the rework reopening, but still behind the external live head; it did not adopt the ambient head
capabilities.limitations: reconciliation advances to the proven effect head, not to an arbitrary external source commit

capabilities.authority: new DSH Session + durable ProjectIR/journal/Work state
capabilities.observed: P used a new DSH home and a new Session; no previous session store; it discovered the promotion, the unpromoted attempt and its worktree, the journal, the vendor update, the newsletter and the head divergence
capabilities.limitations: the continuation assessment and result content are not exposed as model-facing fields; the Agent recovered the technical worktree through ordinary filesystem access

capabilities.composedInNormalHost: enabled in both P and F profiles
capabilities.observed: P did not spawn a child; contaminated F used none; clean F blocked before the model turn
capabilities.limitations: no valid F comparison was obtained

shortestCompleteRealPath: D2 work delegation -> execution world -> completion evaluation -> ATTEMPT_RESULT + evidence
package continuation inspect (EXACT/INCOMPATIBLE; NO model-facing tool)
packaged continuation: INCOMPATIBLE; expert kernel: EXACT/COMPATIBLE/INCOMPATIBLE/UNKNOWN
governed rework: permit + reopen; D2 execution refused at HEAD_BASIS_MISMATCH when the live head is ahead of the canonical head
fresh DSH Session reads durable project state + ordinary files -> continuation note
missingSeams: no model-facing Project Intent tool and no normal-host admission authority
packaged continuation uses wholeRepositoryRead, so COMPATIBLE is unreachable for any source change
the packaged result content is not exposed as a model field; the Agent reads the execution world on disk
the live external source revision and the canonical project head can diverge; rework execution uses the canonical head
reconcileProjectHead does not adopt an arbitrary external commit, and can be blocked by a non-quiescent task
